verdict.rationale: A probe found a published OpenAPI spec at grafana.com/api/openapi.json, which shows a machine-readable public API. First-party docs also describe defining dashboards, data sources and other configuration as code, plus terminal-based admin for CI/CD pipelines. An official MCP server and a CLI give agents further documented programmatic entry points. Missing for 10: no first-party HTTP API reference excerpt in the pack, no evidence of endpoint coverage or auth details, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of driving the product through the API.
